rules.title: Low free space on the Windows system volume
rules.description: Limited free system-volume space can prevent updates, application writes, and normal paging.
rules.recommendation: Review disk usage and identify safe-to-remove files; do not delete user files automatically.

rules.title: Sustained high memory pressure
rules.description: High observed memory use may contribute to paging and application delays.
rules.recommendation: Collect a time-series sample and inspect memory-heavy processes before considering changes.

rules.title: One or more Plug and Play devices report a problem
rules.description: Windows device configuration reports a non-zero problem code.
rules.recommendation: Inspect the device and its signed driver version in Device Manager; do not install an unverified driver.
